name: Koori Suisei no Quartet
source: One day the protagonist is led by a mysterious stone, and meets a boy and a girl who elegantly dances in the ice rink. You all have the same goal of winning the gold medal at the Olympics. As friends, and sometimes as rivals, this is the story of figure skaters who compete in the beautiful yet cruel world of Figure Skating.
translation: 某天，主角在一块神秘石头的指引下，遇见了在溜冰场上翩翩起舞的一对少年和少女。你们都有一个共同的目标：在奥运会上赢得金牌。这是花样滑冰运动员作为朋友，有时作为对手，在美丽而残酷的花样滑冰世界中竞争的故事。
